name: Lubbock County, TX
findings: Lubbock County has 913 nonprofit organizations. 329 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 246 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Lubbock County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 84 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 84 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few hobby and sports organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 3 hobby and sports organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 8 would.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through hobby and sports groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Union organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 7 union organizations here list membership, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do union organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
